references.observed: Actually inspected complete bell,light stone circular pedestal andseparate broken lower-rim fragment. Green/brown patinated bronze,flared lip,narrower sloping body,rounded shoulder/waist bands,crown withopen cast handles,onion-shaped cap andplain cross. Real large broken wedge hasthick jagged edges anda recessed fine dark safety grille. Shallow original geometric ornament canreplace figurative relief/text;do notcopy inscriptions orportraits. Fragment leans independently beside thepedestal.
